name: Kagura Reimeiki ~Chihaya no Shou~ Ni
original_name: 神楽黎明記～ちはやの章～弐
source:
Inudou Chihaya, who had passed the graduation exam at Kijimori Shrine had become an  official exorcist shrine maiden. She was now traveling to meet up with her former training companions.
Along the way, she stopped by a small village.

Chihaya noticed something off. When she asked the villagers, they explained that  yokai troubled them and that they had been appearing rather frequently.

"Leave it to me," she said, eager to help the villagers while also using the opportunity to hone her skills as a warrior.
But…

[Translated from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_10/index.html]the official website[/url]]
